notes.title: Lost Woods Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G8a6Uiizanw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]On the first mayor update for Cosmic Magus we are taking a heavy inspiration from the Zelda game's most infamous area- The Lost Woods, first featured in the Ocarina of Time.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AXAuAnY.png[/img]
[b]NEW ENEMY: SCRUBLING[/b]
Local to the Lost Woods area, this little fellow is not afraid of traveling to the edge of the cosmos to face against the Cosmic Magus. Be careful as they will spawn on every map.

They can cast Boomerang, Brambles and Morph.

There are a bunch of new features as well, here is a list below.

[olist]
[*]New map, enemy and spells.
[*]New training mode.
[*]New map select menu.
[*]New cosmetics to customize your magus.
[*]New spells and enemy sounds.
[*]New animations
[*]New voicelines
[*]Change use/steal spell keys in options.
[*]Enable/disable enemy sounds.
[/olist]

There are more updates planned for the future. If you have any questions and/or feedback, please do leave a comment down below.

Have fun stealing spells!
-David
